data.narrative:
Reflex Robotics is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $7M to date. The broader Robotics & Manufacturing sector comprises one public comparable (277810.KQ) and eight private peers including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI, though none represent sufficiently tight stage and valuation alignment for reliable peer-median analysis.

Given the limited comparable universe at this stage, valuation relies on stage-progression methodology. Using total capital raised ($7M) as a proxy for entry valuation and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-Series A advancement yields an implied valuation of $18M. This represents the single analytically defensible anchor point available from the data.

The triangulated range of $15M to $20M (median $18M) reflects reasonable variance around this single method. Key uncertainties include the absence of tighter stage peers, which limits calibration of the step-up multiplier to Reflex's specific risk profile and market conditions, and the modest data density in early-stage robotics valuations generally. Investors should view the $18M median as the most supported estimate, while recognizing material downside risk ($15M) if deployment metrics or technical validation lag peer expectations, and modest upside ($20M) conditional on near-term funding milestones or market traction evidence.
